title: Can You Spot the Real Order Block? 🧠 #ICTTrading Quiz
description: Think you know ICT order blocks? 90% of traders fail this one. Test yourself and see where you really stand. R2F Trading has been breaking down smart money concepts for 10+ years — follow for daily setups and free resources at r2ftrading.com.
script: Stop. 90% of traders misidentify order blocks every single day. Can YOU spot the real one? Here's the question. Two candles. Both look like order blocks. Which one is valid — A or B? Option A — the last down candle before a big move up. Option B — a random bearish candle mid-range. Most beginners pick B. Looks strong. Big red candle. Feels right. It's a trap. The answer is A. The REAL order block is the last opposing candle BEFORE displacement. That's the ICT rule. No displacement? No valid order block. It's that simple.
